title: Mushroom Grove
description: The tunnel widens into a small underground grove where giant mushrooms tower overhead, their caps dripping with moisture. Thick fungal fibers hang like curtains from the stalks, and clusters of bioluminescent spores cling to every surface. A hollowed-out stump nearby shows signs of a previous camp.

choices.label: Harvest the fibers
choices.description: Strip the thick fungal fibers from the mushroom stalks.

outcomes.text: The fibers peel away in long, strong strips. Good quality material -- whoever set up camp here knew this was a prime spot.
As you strip the stalks, you disturb a colony of luminescent beetles. They scatter, revealing a thick deposit of glowing spores beneath the bark.
The stalk you're stripping suddenly splits, releasing a pocket of trapped gas. The stench is overwhelming and your eyes burn for minutes.

choices.label: Gather the threads
choices.description: Collect the fine mycelium threads from the root network.

outcomes.text: The root network here is dense and well-established. You pull free armfuls of quality mycelium thread.
Excellent threads, and the root system has trapped bits of metal -- old nails and fittings from the camp, absorbed by the mycelium.
The threads are tangled with stinging tendrils. Your hands swell and itch, but you manage a decent bundle.

choices.label: Search the old camp
choices.description: Someone left supplies in that hollowed stump.

outcomes.text: Inside the stump you find a traveler's lockbox, rusted but intact. A decent pile of coin and a few dried provisions.
The stump holds more than expected -- coin, fiber bundles, and a carefully sealed jar of spore clusters.
You reach inside and something bites. A cave spider! You jerk back with a few coins and a throbbing hand.
